text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Entering her Senior Year, Mejiro Ramonu 
trained with even greater intensity. 
However, she found herself tiring more 
easily than before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu shares her heartfelt 
thoughts with the Trainer. Just like 
flowers that wither, the body of any 
Umamusume will eventually age.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I must fall, I want to fall at the 
height of my beauty. That is why I wish to 
remain in my prime for the rest of my 
life...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moved by those feelings, the Trainer's 
heart burned with passion. To showcase 
perfect love in the supreme race, the two 
aimed for even greater heights.
